about_the_game:
Dive into the world of EleBall Circus and its brightest star—Eddie the Elephant!

EleBall is a fun, easy-to-pick-up arcade adventure about Eddie—a circus elephant who tries their best to catch falling objects while simultaneously keeping their balance on a bouncy ball.

Keep your balance while holding falling objects and watching out for hazards. Score big and the crowds will love you! Adjust to the situation in order to survive in the harsh world of the circus.

The more you work, the more money you earn. You can use it to buy new outfits and balls for Eddie. With over 80 unique items, pick your favorites to really create your dream EleBaller.

Tired of playing against a timer? Do you want to just take it easy, or get weird with different modifiers? Then check out the Freeplay mode, where you can pick any level background and music along with modifiers to suit your experience. Want to start your own Elephant Space Program? We've got you covered!

Rolling through the game, you'll uncover bits and pieces of the secret that lies behind EleBall Circus. Can you balance your way out of this mysterious tale?

Minimum:
  • OS: yes
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Dual-Core T4300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 210M
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Weakest tested hardware

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2415M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6630M (256 MB VRAM)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Unity supports Mojave 10.14+, but we don't have a machine to test this with. If it doesn't work. please let us know!
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Sequoia 15.1+
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2, Apple Silicon
  • Graphics: OpenGL or Metal capable GPU
  • Additional Notes: We tested this OSX version—it works.
